dedupe_keys.name: ethiopia potential settlement expansion areas from building clusters outside known settlements 3is

description: 3iSolution published an initial analysis on HDX in January 2025 that flags possible new settlements and urban growth in Ethiopia. It takes buildings detected by Google Open Buildings that lie outside the settlements recognised by GRID3 and groups them in two clustering passes, one at 500 metres to find broader areas where many buildings concentrate and one at 100 metres to separate tighter clusters such as individual settlement units or neighbourhoods inside those areas. Coverage: Ethiopia, from building detections dated 2023 onward. Access: one zipped Shapefile on HDX. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the provider calls it an initial indication that needs validation with high-resolution imagery, population data, local knowledge and ground truthing, and it inherits errors from both input datasets. Simulation uses are identifying settlement growth that is missing from official settlement layers, for exposure updates and for planning services and infrastructure to new areas. Related records: Google Open Buildings and the GRID3 settlement data.
